reviews.body:
Thanks for this - a good catch, and a clean fix. This has been silently wrong since the Bloom commands were first written: the server looks `EXPANSION` up by keyword and ignores a stray value while still replying `OK`, so nothing ever flagged it. Thanks also for calling out the `expansion` + `nonscaling` behaviour change in the description; we'll carry that into the release notes.

I've pushed one extra commit to your branch (33ce98b), I hope that's OK: `TestReserveWithExpansion` and `TestReserveWithExpansionAsync`. Because the server accepts the malformed command, an args-level test can't tell whether the option took effect, so these reserve a filter with `expansion: 4` and read the rate back via `BF.INFO`, on standalone and cluster. They fail without your one-line fix and pass with it. Your builder test is unchanged.
